working_model: A centered physical signal s and centered additive readout error e are independent, and the observed readout is s+e. The supplied population covariance matrices are exact under this model, not finite-sample estimates. No unknown noise variance is to be fitted.
decision_policy: A nonzero linear readout a^T*(s+e)has signal-to-noise variance ratio(a^T*Cov(s)*a)/(a^T*Cov(e)*a). Optimize this ratio over every real nonzero a. Report a2/a1in ORIGINAL channel coordinates; simultaneous sign and magnitude scaling of a has no effect. Do not optimize total observed variance or rescale the noise covariance without transforming signal as well.
interpretation: Assess whether subtracting the known noise leaves a physically admissible signal covariance and report its rank using1e-9eigenvalue tolerance. A rank-one signal covariance is not proof of a unique biological or mechanical cause.

provenance.data_origin: Explicit controlled benchmark model and exact numerical inputs; not an empirical laboratory, ecological or classifier-performance claim.
